Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: A Mahoraga-inspired boss (8000 HP) waits in an arena at the eastern edge of every world. He adapts to every kind of harm, even drowning, and every adaptation fully heals him and doubles his health and damage. The wheel teaches him Giant Slash, Giant Napalm, Giant Nuke, Electrocute Giant Punch, Holy Shower and World Cutting Slash. Defeat him for two perks: Adapt to Anything, and Summon Mahoraga to call your own Mahoraga with a key you choose in Mod settings.
